metrics.name: Emergency department visits
metrics.summary: Distinct ED encounters (encounter versions de-duplicated) dated in the period.

numerator.summary: Distinct ED encounter_ids (visit.type_concept = 'emergency_visit') with event_date in the period.

hedis_edu.summary: One per patient per date; ED visits ending in inpatient admission excluded (HEDIS EDU).

metrics.sql_template: SELECT count(DISTINCT encounter_id) AS ed_visits FROM visit WHERE type_concept = 'emergency_visit' AND event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: ED visits per 1,000 member-years
metrics.summary: Distinct ED encounters in the period per 1,000 roster member-years (roster headcount x period length in years).

population.summary: Roster patients; member-years approximated from roster headcount and period length (no enrollment spans received).

denominator.summary: Roster patients x days in period / 365.25, divided by 1,000.

numerator.summary: Distinct ED encounter_ids dated in the period.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT round(1000.0 * (SELECT count(DISTINCT encounter_id) FROM visit WHERE type_concept = 'emergency_visit' AND event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}') / ((SELECT count(*) FROM patient) * (julianday('{period_end}') - julianday('{period_start}') + 1) / 365.25), 1) AS ed_per_1000_member_years

metrics.name: Repeat ED users (2+ ED visits, trailing 12 months)
metrics.summary: Patients with two or more distinct ED encounters dated in the trailing 12 months ending at the as-of date (inclusive, 365 days).

numerator.summary: Patients with >= 2 distinct ED encounter_ids with event_date in the window.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT count(*) AS patients FROM (SELECT patient_id FROM visit WHERE type_concept = 'emergency_visit' AND event_date BETWEEN '{window_start}' AND '{as_of}' GROUP BY patient_id HAVING count(DISTINCT encounter_id) >= 2)

metrics.name: Share of ED visits ending in admission or observation
metrics.summary: Percent of completed ED encounters dated in the period whose ED disposition is an inpatient admission or observation placement; denominator = distinct completed ED encounters (disposition known).

denominator.summary: Distinct ED encounter_ids whose latest version is completed (carries the disposition), dated in the period.

numerator.summary: Denominator encounters with disposition admitted, inpatient_admission, observation, hospital_observation or observation_for_mobility.

admit_obs_disposition.provenance: received encounters.disposition vocabulary; admission/observation dispositions per definitions.json inpatient_admission (AHU counts observation)

checks.why: the ED visit's outcome is the disposition on its completed encounter version; ADT linkage events describe a different (downstream-stay) reading

linked_conversion.when: conver|turned into|went on to|led to an? (?:admission|stay)|resulted in a (?:hospital )?stay
linked_conversion.summary: ED-to-hospital conversion: ED encounter linked to a downstream inpatient/observation stay (referring/transferred-from ids or ADT transfer_to_observation).
linked_conversion.sql_template: SELECT round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stay s WHERE s.patient_id = v.patient_id AND s.admit_date BETWEEN v.event_date AND date(v.event_date, '+1 day')) THEN v.encounter_id END) / count(DISTINCT v.encounter_id), 1) AS pct_converted FROM visit v WHERE v.type_concept = 'emergency_visit' AND v.event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.sql_template: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(disposition IN ('admitted','inpatient_admission','observation','hospital_observation','observation_for_mobility')) / count(*), 1) AS pct_admit_or_obs FROM visit WHERE type_concept = 'emergency_visit' AND status = 'completed' AND event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: Patients without a primary care visit in the trailing 12 months
metrics.summary: Roster patients with no in-person primary care encounter (primary care, office, wellness, pediatric office, ambulatory, annual physical) dated in the trailing 12 months ending at the as-of date (inclusive, 365 days). Telephone/virtual, specialty, urgent care and ED contacts do not count.

denominator.summary: Roster patients (count of those without a visit).

numerator.summary: Patients with no qualifying visit in the window.

pcp_visit.provenance: definitions.json primary_care_visit (agere_default: primary care, office, wellness, pediatric office and ambulatory types)

metrics.sql_template: SELECT count(*) AS patients FROM patient p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit v WHERE v.patient_id = p.patient_id AND v.type_concept = 'primary_care_visit' AND v.in_person = 1 AND v.event_date BETWEEN '{window_start}' AND '{as_of}')

metrics.name: Attributed patients without an in-person primary care visit at an attributed practice, trailing 12 months
metrics.summary: Attributed patients (latest assigned primary-care relationship) with no in-person primary care encounter held at one of our practices (visit.is_practice = 1) in the trailing 12 months ending at the as-of date (inclusive, 365 days).

population.summary: Attributed patients: care_team_relationships role primary_care/pediatric_primary_care, status assigned (patient.pcp_practice_id).

attribution.why: attribution is the assigned primary-care relationship

numerator.summary: Attributed patients with no qualifying practice visit in the window.

qualifiers.why: only visits held at our practices count for attributed primary care (outside dental/optometry/specialty sites do not)

pcp_visit.provenance: definitions.json primary_care_visit; attribution convention: visits at the attributed network's practices

metrics.sql_template: SELECT count(*) AS patients FROM patient p WHERE p.pcp_practice_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit v WHERE v.patient_id = p.patient_id AND v.type_concept = 'primary_care_visit' AND v.in_person = 1 AND v.is_practice = 1 AND v.event_date BETWEEN '{window_start}' AND '{as_of}')

metrics.name: In-person primary care visits per 1,000 attributed patients, by attributed practice
metrics.summary: By attributed practice: distinct in-person primary care encounters held at our practices in the period, for patients attributed to that practice, per 1,000 attributed patients (headcount).

attribution.why: attribution is the assigned primary-care relationship's practice

numerator.summary: Distinct qualifying encounters of those patients in the period (counted for the attributed practice even when seen at another of our practices).

qualifiers.why: only visits held at our practices count (outside specialty/dental/optometry sites do not)

metrics.sql_template: SELECT p.pcp_practice_id AS practice, count(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS attributed_patients, count(DISTINCT v.encounter_id) AS visits, round(1000.0 * count(DISTINCT v.encounter_id) / count(DISTINCT p.patient_id), 1) AS per_1000 FROM patient p LEFT JOIN visit v ON v.patient_id = p.patient_id AND v.type_concept = 'primary_care_visit' AND v.in_person = 1 AND v.is_practice = 1 AND v.event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}' WHERE p.pcp_practice_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.pcp_practice_id ORDER BY p.pcp_practice_id

metrics.name: Acute inpatient stays per 1,000 member-years
metrics.summary: Distinct inpatient stays (stay.type = 'inpatient', collapsed by admit day and overlap) admitted in the period per 1,000 roster member-years.

population.summary: Roster patients; member-years from roster headcount x period length.

numerator.summary: Inpatient stays with admit_date in the period.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT round(1000.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM stay WHERE type = 'inpatient' AND admit_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}') / ((SELECT count(*) FROM patient) * (julianday('{period_end}') - julianday('{period_start}') + 1) / 365.25), 1) AS admits_per_1000_member_years

metrics.name: Observation stays
metrics.summary: Distinct hospital observation stays (stay.type = 'observation'; encounter and ADT versions collapsed) admitted in the period.

numerator.summary: Observation stays with admit_date in the period.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT count(*) AS observation_stays FROM stay WHERE type = 'observation' AND admit_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: Average inpatient length of stay (days)
metrics.summary: Mean stay.los_days of inpatient stays with a received discharge (discharge_known = 1), anchored on admit_date in the period; stays with unknown discharge are excluded, never counted as 0 days.

population.summary: Inpatient stays with a known discharge.

denominator.summary: Inpatient stays with los_days not null.

checks.why: length of stay comes from the collapsed stay (stay.los_days), not encounter rows

metrics.sql_template: SELECT round(avg(los_days), 2) AS avg_los_days FROM stay WHERE type = 'inpatient' AND los_days IS NOT NULL AND admit_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: Average observation stay length (hours)
metrics.internal_reason: Operational timing metric; no published standard fixes the clock (start_time to end_time of the observation encounter is the Agere convention).
metrics.summary: Mean hours from start_time to end_time of observation encounters (one per encounter_id) dated in the period; encounters without both times are excluded.

population.summary: Observation encounters with start and end times.

checks.why: hours need the encounter clock times (start_time/end_time), not day counts

metrics.sql_template: SELECT round(avg((julianday(end_time) - julianday(start_time)) * 24), 1) AS avg_obs_hours FROM visit WHERE type_concept = 'observation_stay' AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: 30-day all-cause readmission rate
metrics.summary: Percent of hospital stays discharged in the period followed by a new stay starting within 30 days of discharge (all-cause; planned readmissions not excluded).

population.summary: Stays with a known discharge in the period.

denominator.summary: Stays with discharge_date in the period.

hedis_pcr.summary: Exclude planned readmissions and pregnancy/perinatal index stays (needs procedure/diagnosis detail).

metrics.sql_template: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(readmitted_30d) / count(*), 1) AS readmission_rate FROM stay WHERE discharge_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'

metrics.name: Outpatient follow-up within 7 days of hospital discharge
metrics.summary: Percent of hospital discharges (ADT discharge events of inpatient/observation encounters, each event once) whose patient has an in-person outpatient visit (primary care types or specialist office/follow-up) 1-7 days after the discharge date; same-day, telephone/virtual, urgent care, ED and home-health contacts do not count. Discharge date = the ADT discharge event's local business date (stay.discharge_date is the UTC date of the discharge time, one day later for evening discharges). Discharges in the trailing 12 months, ending 7 days before the as-of date so every follow-up window is fully observed.

population.summary: Inpatient and observation encounters with an ADT discharge event.

denominator.summary: ADT discharge events (inpatient/observation encounters) dated from the window start through as-of minus 7 days.

numerator.summary: Denominator discharges with a qualifying visit 1-7 days after discharge.

followup_visit.provenance: definitions.json primary_care_visit + specialist office visits; HEDIS-style in-person follow-up

metrics.sql_template: WITH dc AS (SELECT a.record_id, a.patient_id, a.event_date AS discharge_day FROM record a JOIN visit e ON e.encounter_id = json_extract(a.payload,'$.encounter_id') WHERE a.stream = 'adt' AND json_extract(a.payload,'$.event') = 'discharge' AND e.type_concept IN ('inpatient_admission','observation_stay') AND a.event_date BETWEEN '{window_start}' AND '{index_end}') SELECT round(100.0 * sum(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit v WHERE v.patient_id = dc.patient_id AND v.in_person = 1 AND v.type_concept IN ('primary_care_visit','specialist_visit') AND julianday(v.event_date) - julianday(dc.discharge_day) BETWEEN 1 AND 7)) / count(*), 1) AS pct_followup_7d FROM dc

checks.why: the discharge date is the ADT discharge event date (local business date); stay.discharge_date is the UTC date of the discharge time and runs one day late for evening discharges, which shifts the 1-7 day follow-up window

metrics.name: Follow-up within 7 days of an ED visit
metrics.summary: Percent of distinct ED encounters in the period followed by a primary care, specialist or telehealth contact on the ED date or within 7 days after (HEDIS FMC 8-day window; 1-7 days when the question says 'after').

denominator.summary: Distinct ED encounter_ids dated in the period.

numerator.summary: ED encounters with a qualifying follow-up contact 0-7 days later.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit b WHERE b.patient_id = e.patient_id AND b.encounter_id <> e.encounter_id AND b.type_concept IN ('primary_care_visit','specialist_visit','telehealth_contact') AND julianday(b.event_date) - julianday(e.event_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 7) THEN e.encounter_id END) / count(DISTINCT e.encounter_id), 1) AS pct_followup_7d FROM visit e WHERE e.type_concept = 'emergency_visit' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}'
